prompt:
Workspace search is misbehaving. Support has collected these reports; the product notes under docs/product/search-notes.md describe the search features.

1. A Starter customer searched for "Release 2: hotfix", the exact title of one of their issues, and was told that field-scoped search is not included in their plan. Anything with a colon in it does this, and they get no results at all.
2. An Enterprise customer typed "kind:comment flaky" in the search dialog. The dialog's hint line says it understood "searching comments", but the results are empty, although a comment containing "flaky" exists. The same happens with "in:comments flaky" and with "project:… deploy": the words are searched literally instead of narrowing the search.
3. Searching within a project never returns comments, only issues, even comments on that project's own issues. The customer ran the "rebuild search index" job for their workspace; it made no difference.
4. Searching for "100%" returns every issue in the workspace. Searching for "snake_case" also matches "snake case".
5. On a Growth workspace the command palette's results include comments, although the plan does not include searching anything but issues.
6. Ops used the "reindex this item" tool on a comment and on a project after an index clean-up. It reported success, but neither is searchable afterwards. The same tool brought an archived issue back into the results.

Expected behaviour: search behaves as the repository's documentation specifies, everywhere a search document is written or read. The documents under docs/ say how they rank.

This is a `fix` task: edit the code and stop. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
notes: BROWNFIELD fix: search query semantics. bug.patch adds docs/README.md (precedence: ADR > product note > support note; comments/TODOs are not documentation; code behaviour + sibling conventions where no document speaks), docs/adr/0007-search-query-language.md (authoritative) and the older docs/product/search-notes.md (conflicting), and injects: (a) search-service `normaliseQuery()` whose comment claims it strips the dialog's field tokens but only trims whitespace, with the pristine `q.includes(":")` refusal kept; (b) the kinds narrowing removed from the search Server Action and the API route, both now carrying stale comments saying the service narrows (it does not); (c) the visible search test moved to an enterprise tenant and its colon-refusal assertion dropped. Latent in pristine and described by the reports: LIKE wildcards unescaped (`%`, `_`, and the escape char), comment documents written with projectId null, `search.reindex_requested` handled for issues only and re-indexing archived issues, `SearchSubjectKind` declared three times (components parser, repository, zod schema), the client parser (components/domain/search/query-syntax.ts) duplicated nowhere on the server. OMITTED RULES (not in the prompt) and their evidence: tokens `kind:`/`in:` (plural tolerated) override the caller's kinds, `project:` overrides projectId, unknown and empty-valued tokens are dropped -> ADR 0007 section 2 and the pristine client parser which already implements exactly that; an org-level override enables the language on a Starter workspace -> ADR section 4 plus the flag convention: `advanced_search` is declared overridable in config/feature-flags.ts and the pristine service already evaluates it with the org's overrides; `total` counts only the kinds actually searched -> ADR section 4 plus the Page contract (repository counts with the same predicates it lists with); the backslash is literal -> ADR section 1 plus the repository docblock ("substring match"); a reindex request for an archived issue leaves it out -> ADR section 7 plus the sibling `issue.archived` listener which removes the document; a `project:` token for another workspace's project returns nothing -> the orgPredicate on every repository read. DOCUMENT CONFLICTS: (1) product note: a colon on a plan without advanced search is refused with 'Field-scoped search is not included in this plan' vs ADR section 3: free text, never refused -> README rule 2, ADR wins; (2) product note: comments carry no project in the index, project scope returns issues only vs ADR section 6: comments are indexed under their issue's project on every write path -> ADR wins. DEBT / LIVE COPIES: the rule 'a comment document carries its issue's project' has three live writers that all reach `indexComment` (the comment.created listener, the rebuild job runSearchReindexJob, the reindex-request handler); the rule 'without advanced search only issues are searched' had two copies (action + route) which the patch removes so the service must own it; the parser exists on the client only; `normaliseQuery` is a misleading name. Reference solution (8 files, 310 changed lines; layers lib, components, services, repositories, schemas, actions, app/api): new src/lib/search-query.ts (shared parser with kindTokens, likeContainsPattern + LIKE_ESCAPE_CHAR), components query-syntax re-exports it, search-service parses with it, narrows kinds without the flag, honours tokens, indexComment resolves the issue's project, reindexSubject covers issue/comment/project and drops archived or missing subjects, search-repository matches with LIKE ... ESCAPE, schemas/search derives the kind enum from the lib, repositories/index re-exports the type, action/route comments corrected. HIDDEN TEST: 18 cases (colon as text on Starter; literal would-be syntax + issues-only narrowing on Starter; kind:/in: tokens; project: token scopes issues and comments; unknown and empty tokens dropped; caller's kinds honoured with the flag; issues-only with total on Starter even for projects; override enables the language; % literal; _ literal; backslash literal; case-insensitive; comment under its project on creation; after rebuild job; after reindex request; project reindex request; archived issue stays out after reindex request; project: token never reaches another workspace). TRAPS: A (followed the wrong document) keeps the colon refusal on lower plans -> fails 3 (colon as text, literal syntax on Starter, override case); B (fixed one copy) resolves the comment's project in the comment.created listener only, indexComment still writes null -> fails 2 (rebuild job, reindex request); C (filled a gap by guessing) neutralises wildcards by stripping % and _ from the query -> fails 3 (%, _, backslash); D (fixed one copy) puts the kinds narrowing back into the action and route, service still searches whatever is asked -> fails 2 (Starter literal/narrowing cases). VALIDATION: bug -> patch clean, tsc 0, visible 617/617; hidden on bug 14/18 fail; bug+solution -> tsc 0, hidden 18/18, full 635/635; hidden x3 and full x2 green.
